init.title: Connection tuning
init.description:
Experimental. Leave off unless mesh disconnects persist.

When on, light, switch and fan commands are sent without waiting for the bulb to acknowledge each write, which is the mode Telink recommends for control commands. The trade-off: a stuck connection no longer shows up as a write timeout, so if lights stop responding while the mesh still reports connected, turn this back off. Saving reloads the integration.

data.write_without_response: Send commands without waiting for acknowledgement

data_description.write_without_response: Off by default. Telink's recommended mode for control commands, but not yet verified on Cync bulbs behind ESPHome proxies.

unknown_devices.title: Unrecognized Cync devices on your mesh
unknown_devices.description:
{count} device(s) are reporting status on your Cync mesh but are not in this integration's device list: {devices}.

This usually means they were paired in the Cync app after the integration was set up. Use **Reconfigure** on the Cync BLE integration to re-sync your device list and add them.

This notice clears itself once the re-sync completes.
